tools.name: generate_text_qr_code
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a PNG and SVG QR image that displays plain text when scanned. Accepts up to 1,500 characters, preserves whitespace, and reports contrast, density and optional print width. Encoded UTF-8 content must fit 1,273–2,953 bytes depending on error correction. Static codes only;
